parameters.query:
SELECT
  b.id AS booking_id,
  b.booking_code,
  b.guest_name,
  b."propertyId",
  b."checkIn",
  b."checkOut",
  b.fnrh_ok,
  b.doc_ok,
  b.form_ok,
  b.comprovante_ok,
  p.title AS property_title,
  p.rules AS property_rules,
  p.bedrooms,
  p.neighborhood,
  p.default_deposit_amount
FROM bookings b
JOIN properties p ON p.id = b."propertyId"
WHERE upper(b.booking_code) = $1
LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO security_deposits (
  id, booking_id, property_id, amount, booking_code, guest_name, guest_phone,
  checkout_url, infinite_reference, status, metadata
) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8,$9,'pending',$10::jsonb)
ON CONFLICT (booking_id) DO UPDATE SET
  checkout_url = EXCLUDED.checkout_url,
  infinite_reference = EXCLUDED.infinite_reference,
  status = 'pending',
  amount = EXCLUDED.amount,
  metadata = EXCLUDED.metadata,
  "updatedAt" = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at = now()
RETURNING id;
